# Pilot Requirements Quality Checklist: Pilot Environments

**Purpose**: Gate 2 review of how well the requirements cover:
- the pilot and its golden template;
- packaging and provisioning;
- synthetic data;
- prod-sim rollout and traffic;
- faults;
- isolation and observability.

**Created**: 2026-11-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [research.md](../research.md) · [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Pilot and Template

- [X] CHK001 Is the pilot's behaviour fully specified: the inputs, the answer fields, the routing order (security first, then catalogue owner, then category rules, then first line) and the "never closes incidents" rule? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, research R-05]
- [X] CHK002 Are the fill points, their rules and their failure messages defined precisely enough for T3 (feature 011) to fill and for a build to reject? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, data-model]
- [X] CHK003 Is it clear that the agent code and infrastructure definitions are fixed and only configuration is filled? [Consistency, Spec Clarifications]
- [X] CHK004 Are the edge-case behaviours (unknown service, security, multi-service review, unavailable model, planted data without a fault) specified as requirements, not only as edge cases? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]

## Packaging and Provisioning

- [X] CHK005 Is "everything that determines behaviour" in the package hash defined (code, reference data, infrastructure definitions, fill) and is determinism measurable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-003, SC-001, research R-02]
- [X] CHK006 Are the environment operations (create, status, tear down) specified with refusals (unknown hash, undeclared setting, already running) and records? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, contracts]
- [X] CHK007 Is the decision to run packages as processes inside environment hosts (no Docker socket) recorded with its security rationale and its post-MVP path? [Assumption, research R-03]
- [X] CHK008 Are the follow-ups for features 010 (MCP tools and resources, T3–T5 tool scopes) and 011 (T3 calls; subagents within SA §7.1) stated as dependencies? [Dependency, Spec Assumptions]

## Data and Models

- [X] CHK009 Are the incident fields, categories, priorities, edge cases and expected answers defined, with reproducibility by seed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, §FR-008, data-model]
- [X] CHK010 Is the planted personal data limited, marked and never echoed outside the leak fault? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009, Edge Cases]
- [X] CHK011 Is the simulated model's behaviour, the real-model option (where allowed, which settings, which fallback) and the cost implication clear? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, research R-05]

## Prod-sim, Traffic and Faults

- [X] CHK012 Are the shadow, canary and full semantics (who answers, what is recorded, how the share is assigned) unambiguous and measurable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, SC-003, research R-06]
- [X] CHK013 Is "online routing accuracy" defined (what counts as correct, window) so the model swap's effect is measurable by T8? [Measurability, Spec §FR-016, SC-005]
- [X] CHK014 Are fault behaviours (effect size, refusal when active, revert, records) and the leak detection method specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, SC-006]
- [X] CHK015 Are traffic generator counts, rate tolerance and pausing specified, including timeouts? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, SC-004]

## Isolation, Observability and Compatibility

- [X] CHK016 Is the network isolation stated for both directions, with the declared exceptions (Jaeger, feature 010's MCP servers) and how it is tested? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, SC-007, research R-09]
- [X] CHK017 Are trace contents (request id, package hash, no incident text) and the pilot's records defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, research R-10]
- [X] CHK018 Is the separation between the platform and the pilot (no imports either way, own settings, no platform secrets) testable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-017]
- [X] CHK019 Are the document updates (SA §14 and the demo script to the Incident Triage Assistant) in scope? [Consistency, research R-11]
- [X] CHK020 Is it stated that the 003–008 suites are unaffected (no platform code changes beyond Compose and static tests)? [Consistency, Spec §SC-008]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` when satisfied. Fixes go into spec.md, plan.md, research.md or the contracts
  before `/speckit-tasks`.
- `/speckit-implement` reads this checklist's state but does not change it.
